kebab_example: aliyun kms connect-kms-instance --kms-instance-id 'kst-phzz64f722a1buamw0****' --vpc-id 'vpc-bp19z7cwmltad5dff****' --zone-ids cn-hangzhou-k,cn-hangzhou-j --vswitchids 'vsw-bp1i512amda6d10a0****' --km-provider Aliyun --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConnectKmsInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the KMS instance to enable
parameters.name: kms_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) for the KMS instance
parameters.help_zh: 为KMS实例设置专有网络VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: Sets two zones for the KMS instance. Dual-zone load balancing improves service availability and disaster recovery capabilities
parameters.help_zh: 为KMS实例设置两个可用区。通过双可用区负载均衡，提高服务可用性与容灾能力
parameters.name: zone_ids

parameters.help_en: Sets a vSwitch for the dual-zone deployment. The vSwitch must have at least one available IP address
parameters.help_zh: 设置双可用区下的一个交换机，并且该交换机至少有1个可用IP
parameters.name: vswitchids

parameters.help_en: The provider of the KMS instance. Currently, only Aliyun is supported
parameters.help_zh: KMS实例提供商。目前取值仅支持Aliyun
parameters.name: km_provider

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
